post.title: Fortnite is free. How did it make $9B+ in 2018-19?
post.ig:
Fortnite is free. It still made over $9 billion in 2018 and 2019.
Epic's own figures, made public in its fight with Apple: about $5.48B in 2018 and $3.71B in 2019.
In 2021 testimony, CEO Tim Sweeney said: "V-Bucks themselves don't have a marginal cost."
On March 19, 2026, Epic cut its $8.99 pack from 1,000 V-Bucks to 800. Our math: about 25% more per V-Buck.
In June 2026, Epic said it had paid creators over $1B since 2023. In 2022 it agreed to $245M in refunds over what the FTC alleged were "dark patterns."
Sources: Epic v. Apple court record (2021), Fortnite.com (Mar 2026), FTC (Dec 2022), GamesBeat (Jun 2026).
